title: Hoshino Ichika — Hoping For Clear Skies〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, let's stop here for today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Phew... Great work...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Finally... Back to back days of this is so hard...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: On the other hand, you've all been getting so much better. You can really tell just by listening!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You in particular, Ichika. Your singing's improved dramatically, hasn't it?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh... It has?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup, she's right♪ When I hear you sing, Ichi, it gets me all fired up and motivated to play even better!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha! You say you're tired, but it still sounds like you're ready for more!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But make sure not to overdo it, okay? It's important to take breaks too, especially since you're all in such a good mood.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Taking a break...
It is almost spring so...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! The cherry blossoms are all blooming, so we should go see them together!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds lovely!
I'll bring the food if we do go!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
R-Really?! You hear that, Ichi, Shiho?!
Not only are we gonna get to see some beautiful cherry blossoms together, we get to eat Hona's delicious cooking while we do!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. We heard.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Cherry blossoms, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (The ones from that park were in full bloom too. I can't wait...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What about you, Shiho...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (She's been spending all of her time working with us and helping us improve. It feels like she hardly has any personal time anymore...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Please, Shiho!
We only have morning practice that day, so we can go then!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, that's true...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wait, Saki...
The weather forecast said that it might rain then...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Rain? Then how about next week...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, we'll be fine♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What if we do this, Shiho? If it isn't raining that day, we go see the cherry blossoms right after practice!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay, that works.
Oh, but don't blame me if it starts raining.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I won't! But promise me too, okay♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Would it be alright if I talked to Miku and Luka about this too?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Do you wanna come see them with us?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'd love to!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, of course!
Hehe. All of us together♪
It's gonna be so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, it should be.
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Humhumhum♪
Cherry blossoms, cherry blossoms♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Say, Saki...
Are you sure about only going to see them if it isn't raining...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It really could rain, so we could've just moved it back until next week, no?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That may be true, but what if they're all gone by then? If we're gonna go see them, why not while they're in full bloom?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And we'll definitely be able to go! I even know the perfect way to make sure it'll be sunny♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The perfect way?
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ta-daa! Here it is!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So many pieces of cloth... What do you plan on doing?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: These are all leftovers from when Tsukasa made costumes and props and stuff! Aren't they great? They're so shiny and sparkly!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's true, but what does this have to do with making sure it'll be sunny...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh... First, we take one of the white pieces of cloth, round it up into a ball...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Take one of the sparkly cloths to cover it up and...! Ta-da! Your very own lucky weather charm♪ You can even tie a cute, little ribbon onto it too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Umm...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, don't tell me you forgot?
The four of us made these in elementary school to make sure it'd be sunny for an outing we really wanted to go on!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So as long as we all make them, it'll be sunny for sure!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So here...!
Your turn, Ichi♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, is this any different from just praying for good weather?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, don't say that!
These mean way more than just some words and they physically represent our wishes!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, I guess that's a nicer way to put it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But rain or shine, how will things turn out...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (What does Shiho actually want to do...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, which cloths do you want to use?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hmm...
I'll try the sparkly blue one.
It's like the night sky in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that's a good choice!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I also have a bunch of buttons that we can use as eyes too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'm not really sure what Shiho wants to do or how things will turn out, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I do want to go see those cherry blossoms with everyone.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Here's to hoping for a sunny day!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup!
